abilities.title_en: Each time Cheetor completes a Light or Medium Melee Combo he gains {{var_3}} of his Max Power over {{var_4}}.

abilities.desc_en: Each time Cheetor completes a Light or Medium Melee Combo he gains {{var_3}} of his Max Power over {{var_4}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 近战关键命中：
abilities.desc_en: Critical Melee Hits:

abilities.title_en: Critical Melee Hits have a {{var_5}} Chance to inflict Bleed, dealing {{var_6}} of attack over {{var_7}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 近战暴击有 {{var_5}} 几率造成流血，造成 {{var_6}} 的攻击力超过 {{var_7}}。
abilities.desc_en: Critical Melee Hits have a {{var_5}} Chance to inflict Bleed, dealing {{var_6}} of attack over {{var_7}}.

abilities.title_en: Bleeding opponents generate {{var_8}} less power when struck.
abilities.desc_zh: 流血的对手被击中时产生的力量会减少 {{var_8}}。
abilities.desc_en: Bleeding opponents generate {{var_8}} less power when struck.

abilities.desc_zh: 猛冲和重击：
abilities.desc_en: Dashing and Heavy Attacks:

abilities.title_en: Cheetor has a {{var_9}} chance to Evade Ranged Attacks and a {{var_10}} chance that the projectiles will Miss completely.
abilities.desc_zh: 猎豹有 {{var_9}} 几率躲避远程攻击，并有 {{var_10}} 几率使射弹完全脱靶。
abilities.desc_en: Cheetor has a {{var_9}} chance to Evade Ranged Attacks and a {{var_10}} chance that the projectiles will Miss completely.

abilities.desc_zh:
猎豹的快乐本性很快就会被凶猛的攻击性所征服。一旦他达到了极限，他的野性火花就会赋予他令人难以置信的速度，让他能够在对手做出反应之前消灭他们。

当填充能量条时：

猎豹获得野性打击增益，获得 {{var_11}} 暴击率，并且他的攻击会忽略装甲、护盾、闪避，并且不会触发敌人的 {{var_12}} 能力。此外，当“野性打击”处于活动状态时，猎豹将获得 {{var_13}} 几率来躲避近战攻击。

每级约+{{var_14}}
abilities.desc_en:
Feral Strike
Cheetor’s jovial nature can be quickly overcome by beastly aggression. Once he has hit his limit, his feral spark grants him incredible speed allowing him to decimate opponents before they are able to react.
When Filling a Bar of Power:
Cheetor gains a Feral Strike Buff, granting {{var_11}} Critical Rate and his attacks ignore Armor, Shielding, Evasion, and do not trigger enemy abilities for {{var_12}}. Additionally, while Feral Strike is active, Cheetor gains a {{var_13}} chance to Evade Melee Attacks.
about +{{var_14}} per level

abilities.desc_en: Allies – Rhinox, Dinobot, Optimus Primal - +{{var_27}}~{{var_28}} Armor.
Enemies – Waspinator, Scorponok - +{{var_29}}~{{var_30}} Attack Rating.

abilities.desc_zh: 重击：只要 Primal 的团队中有 2 个或更多 Beast Wars 机器人，Beast Wars 角色就会获得 {{var_33}} 的 {{var_31}}~{{var_32}} 攻击评级并净化伤害减益。
abilities.desc_en: Beast Purification – Optimus Primal - Heavy Attacks: Beast Wars characters gain {{var_31}}~{{var_32}} Attack Rating for {{var_33}} and Purify Damaging Debuffs as long as there are 2 or more Beast Wars bots on Primal's team.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_34}}~{{var_35}} 躲避对手攻击时，下一击攻击。
abilities.desc_en: Speed Chasers – Sideswipe, Mirage, Bumblebee (DOTM) - +{{var_34}}~{{var_35}} Attack on the next hit when Dodging the opponent's attacks.

abilities.desc_zh: 每次重击后，该机器人都会获得野兽之怒增益，使攻击有 {{var_36}}~{{var_37}} 机会无法被 {{var_38}} 阻挡。
abilities.desc_en: After each Heavy Attack, this bot gains a Beast Fury buff that grants Attacks a {{var_36}}~{{var_37}} chance to be Unblockable for {{var_38}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 所有较低级别的队友都会获得 +{{var_39}} 临界评级。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_39}} Critical Rating.
